conventions.cell_code: row+column of the front-left base cell, "-" opposite base cell; row 1 = front, column A = left as you face the drawer
conventions.grid_rows_r_r1: counted from the BACK (row 1 of the tray UI = back), as the 3D renderer expects
conventions.coordinates: world mm, same frame as the 3D model

drawers.name: Tools — debug, soldering, test
drawers.notes: Top drawer = best reach. ESD mat + shadow-foam cut-outs; an empty outline = missing tool. No solvents or Li-ion in this drawer.

cells.sugg: Iron tips in stand, ESD tweezers, solder wire Sn63/37 0.5 + 0.8 mm, flux pen/gel, brass tip cleaner
Flush cutters, needle-nose pliers, auto wire stripper, precision bit set, hex + Torx L-keys, scalpel
Multimeter + fused leads, test hooks, mini-grabbers, croc jumper leads, USB-C power meter

cells.inv: ST-Link V3 MINIE ×2; USB-TTL CH343 ×4; USB-CAN adapter ×2

cells.sugg: JST PH/XH crimper, ferrule crimper, pin-extraction tool
Banana leads, bench PSU leads, XT60 test pigtails
Digital calipers, steel rule, loupe, UV torch, K-type probe
Saleae Logic Pro 8 (being sourced), spare scope probes
Hot-air nozzles, desoldering pump, wick, Kapton tape, low-melt solder, stencil + squeegee
Wrist straps, heel grounders, ESD bags, lint-free wipes (no solvent bottles in drawers)
SOIC-8 clip, pogo-pin jigs, Tag-Connect cables, ESP-Prog, Pico debug probe
Spare tips, DMM fuses, AA/AAA/CR2032 (no Li-ion packs), spare blades

drawers.name: Controllers & programming boards
drawers.notes: ESD bags; silica gel + humidity card. Front row = boards in use, rows 3–4 = sealed spares (FIFO). Two-tier allowed (≤ 85 mm boxes).

cells.sugg: USB-C breakouts, level shifters, CH340 boards
Unopened spares of row-1 ESP32 boards
Unopened spares of row-1 STM32/RP boards

drawers.name: Connectors & most-used fasteners
drawers.notes: Two-tier: top = quick-grab boxes, bottom = sealed refill. Opening a refill bag = reorder trigger.

cells.sugg: M3 SHCS + button head 4–20 mm, nuts, nylock, washers
Nylon + brass standoff kits M2.5/M3, heat-set inserts M2/M2.5/M3

cells.inv: Barrel connector pairs ×20 (5.5×2.1); screw terminal blocks (5.08 + 3.5 mm)

cells.sugg: Pin headers 1×40 / 2×40 M+F, IC sockets, jumper caps
Heat-shrink, cable ties, spiral wrap, Wago 221
GX12/GX16 aviation, M8/M12 sensor connectors (RS-485/Modbus field wiring)
M-M, M-F, F-F; short silicone wire cuts (spools in A5-2E-2H)
Bootlace ferrules, ring/spade terminals, loose JST/Dupont pins
Sealed bags that top up row 1 fastener cells
Sealed bags that top up row 1 connector cells

drawers.name: Sensors & feedback
drawers.notes: ESD bags; magnets in their own lidded box, away from encoders in storage.

cells.sugg: ToF VL53L0X/L1X, ultrasonic, IR line sensors
Industrial sensor samples incl. large flow meters (now fit here)

drawers.name: Passives, semiconductors & prototyping
drawers.notes: Bottom drawer: heaviest small parts (wire spools, component books). Moisture-sensitive ICs/reels in dry bags + desiccant.

cells.inv: Motor terminal capacitors 100 nF 100 V X7R (bulk)

cells.sugg: Moisture-sensitive ICs in dry bags + desiccant
Part reels in dry bags + desiccant

drawers.name: Comms, LoRaWAN & RF
drawers.notes: Light items at the top. ESD mat; SMA caps on every RF port; never stack on antennas.

cells.sugg: W5500 modules, RJ45 breakouts, PoE splitters
868/915 MHz whips, u.FL→SMA pigtails, SMA adapters + caps
Attenuators, 50 Ω loads, coax jumpers, SMA torque wrench

drawers.name: Motion — motor drivers & motors
drawers.notes: Drivers in the front row (ESD bags), motors behind. Each motor bagged with its cable.

cells.sugg: Manual + wiring card with each drive
Feetech URT-1 bus adapter, BTS7960-class drivers
Large gearmotors (heavy items to the back)

drawers.name: Power & safety
drawers.notes: No Li-ion/LiPo in any drawer — they live in the fire-safe box (zone LB).

cells.sugg: DIN-rail PSU, MCBs, DIN terminal blocks, rail offcuts
Heavy-gauge wire, ring lugs, cable glands

drawers.name: Mechanical & motion hardware
drawers.notes: Heavy: check slide rating. Silica gel against rust. Stock up to ~1.6 m lies across row 3; longer stock → wall rack (LR).

cells.inv: Pendulum pivot bearings 6800ZZ ×6; shaft collars 8 mm ×10
Shaft couplers ×6 (5–8 mm); JGB37 motor brackets + couplers ×4

cells.sugg: Rods, lead screws, 2020 extrusion offcuts — laid across the drawer
Small plates/profiles, aluminium and acrylic offcuts

drawers.name: CNC, laser & 3D-print parts
drawers.notes: Heaviest drawer at the bottom; spindles in the back row (closest to the slide support). Cutters in tip-protected cases.

cells.inv: 3.175 milling cutter set; 3.175 HRC55 metal cutter (3); HRC55 taper ball knife (3); single-blade spiral pointed knife (2)

cells.sugg: Nozzles, PTFE tube, hotend spares (filament in a dry box, not here)

cells.inv: Keychain material pack (5); constellation material (2); visual overlay material (1)
10 W laser engraving kit (TTS / TTS PRO)

cells.sugg: Spare collets, couplers, limit switches for the machines

drawers.name: Displays, SBCs & HMI panels
drawers.notes: Fragile: screens face-up on foam, never stacked more than 2. Row 6 stays partly inside the cabinet when open — boxed spares only.

cells.sugg: Board + PSU + serial lead (under Ubuntu evaluation)
Boxed spare panels — row 6 is only partly exposed when open

drawers.name: Intake, quarantine & returns
drawers.notes: Wheel it to the door for deliveries. Tags: green = new intake, yellow = untested, red = faulty/RMA. Nothing stays > 7 days.

cells.sugg: Unopened / uncounted shipments — e.g. the Shenzhen boxes
Locked out — never back into stock without a test note
Cartons too big for a bin (row 6 only partly exposed)

drawers.name: Project kits
drawers.notes: Issued stock only: one 400 × 600 mm tote (≤ 160 mm high) per active build. Wheel to the bench. Leftovers go home when a build pauses > 30 days.

drawers.name: Field & demo kits
drawers.notes: Grab-and-go kits for site visits and demos. Power banks / Li-ion stay in zone LB — pack them on the way out.

cells.sugg: Test node, field tester, antennas, SMA adapters, laptop USB-serial
RS-485 tester, crimpers, ferrules, cable ties, labels, spare fuses
Units out for customer evaluation (log in IMS when issued)

zones.name: Lithium battery box
zones.where: Fire-safe LiPo bag / metal box on an open shelf
zones.notes: All Li-ion/LiPo cells and packs. Never in a drawer, away from heat.

zones.name: Long-stock wall rack
zones.notes: Rods, lead screws and extrusions longer than ~1.6 m (shorter stock lies across B4 row 3).
